task_summary: Solve TPP (Travelling Purchase Problem) PDDL planning tasks by reading domain/problem files, generating valid plans using pyperplan via unified_planning, and writing formatted plan output files.
decomposition_rationale: The task is straightforward: parse JSON config, solve PDDL problems with an existing solver stack, format and write plans. The provided solve.py already demonstrates the core workflow. A single skill covers the end-to-end pipeline since parsing, solving, formatting, and output are tightly coupled and the validation approach requires pickle serialization matching the solver output exactly.

skills.name: evo-tpp-solver
skills.description: End-to-end utility for solving TPP PDDL planning tasks: reads problem.json, parses PDDL domain/problem files using unified_planning's PDDLReader, solves each task using pyperplan (with configurable heuristic/search fallbacks), formats actions in the required function-call syntax, writes plan text files, and serializes plans as pickle for validation compatibility.
skills.responsibility: Complete pipeline: JSON config parsing, PDDL parsing, plan generation with pyperplan (with fallback configurations like gbf/hff if default times out), action formatting as 'action_name(arg1, arg2, ...)' strings, writing plan output files, and pickle serialization for validator compatibility.
dr_sections: Configuring Heuristics and Search via UP
